note: C4 reference-and-corner: three new renderer/js production services (reference-selection, corner-segmentation, corner-pairing) plus a new contract module (contracts/r3.0c/reference-and-corner-contract.js, registered in index.js). Sixteen new reason codes split the reference / corner-segmentation / corner-pairing / corner-confirmation refusal semantics (35 → 51 total). Three new capabilities (reference_selection_present, corner_segmentation_present, corner_pairing_present) unlocked at C4_REFERENCE_AND_CORNER. Reference-selection refuses any non-user selection mode per the scope pin (governance/r3.0/train.schema.json :: referenceSelectionPolicy.explicitUserSelectionOnly === true) and refuses caller-forged authoritative flags lacking lapId/sourceId/selectedAt. Corner segmentation is a deterministic data-driven PROPOSAL with full-vs-reduced authority tiers, fingerprint identities (algorithmVersion + rounded normalized start/end), short/overlapping/wrap-spanning candidate fail-closed, and applyUserConfirmation that lifts ONLY proposal authority (telemetry credibility never upgraded — CORNER_CONFIRMATION_CANNOT_UPGRADE_TELEMETRY). Corner pairing requires ≥50% normalized overlap, refuses ordinal pairing and one-to-many ambiguity, surfaces partial coverage (<80%) as a limitation. Adapter gains pure-passthrough selectReference / segmentCorners / applyCornerUserConfirmation / pairCorners / referenceAndCornerForbiddenSelectionModes. State-aware validators (scripts/check-r3-0c-no-consumer.js, scripts/check-r3-0c-guard.js) generalised at C1 automatically extend allowance to the three new renderer/js paths — NO validator weakening at C4. The trusted-verification artifact bound to headSha is the PASS authority; headSha / workflowRunId / artifactId / artifactBoundSha / codexVerdict / createdAt are intentionally null in-commit.
